profileText: a Representative from North Carolina; born in Raleigh, Wake County, N.C., March 5, 1963; graduated from Raleigh Broughton High School, Raleigh, N.C., 1981; graduated from Davidson College, Davidson, N.C., 1985; M.D., University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, N.C. 1989; urologic surgeon; member of the North Carolina state house of representatives, 2015-2019; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Sixteenth Congress, by special election, to fill the vacancy caused by the death of United States Representative Walter Beaman Jones, Jr., and reelected to the three succeeding Congresses (September 10, 2019-present).
